prompt: CSSFontFeatureValuesMap set method exception too many values
answer:
`CSSFontFeatureValuesMap.set()` throws an `InvalidAccessError` when the supplied sequence contains more values than the associated feature block allows.

Examples:

```js
rule.swash.set("toomany", [1, 3]);          // Invalid: swash allows 1 value
rule.characterVariant.set("toomany", [3, 3, 4]); // Invalid: max 2 values
rule.styleset.set("sitedefaults", [3, 7, 13]);   // Valid
```

The method accepts either a single value or an array of values. MDN documents the signature as `set(key, value)`, where `value` must be an integer matching the alternative font feature’s index. ([W3C](https://lists.w3.org/Archives/Public/www-style/2013Jul/0121.html), [MDN](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/CSSFontFeatureValuesMap/set))
